comment: Per-lens sharpness-vs-aperture curves. Edit values here and redeploy; no code changes needed. Schema and a worked example are in data/README.md.

sources.name: Lenstip
sources.testBody: Nikon D200 (10.2MP DX) and Nikon D3x (24.5MP FX), RAW MTF50

sources.name: Photozone/OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: Nikon D3x (24.5MP FX), RAW via Capture One

sources.name: Imaging Resource / SLRgear
sources.testBody: Nikon D200 (10MP DX) and Nikon D3x (24.5MP FX)

sources.name: Photo Art From Science (Ed Dozier)
sources.testBody: Nikon D7100 (24MP DX, about 3.9 µm), MTF50, single copy

entries.wideOpen: Weak: center very good but low contrast; corners barely good
entries.source: Photozone (D3x); Imaging Resource (D3x); Lenstip (D200/D3x); Photo Art From Science (D7100)
entries.note: Imaging Resource: diffraction limiting begins at f/11 (D3x), f/22 still only about 2 blur units. Photo Art From Science (3.9 µm pitch): peak f/8, softening visible at f/16. Corners keep gaining to f/8.

sources.name: Photozone/OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: Nikon D200 (10.2MP DX), neutral DC setting

sources.name: Imaging Resource / SLRgear
sources.testBody: Nikon D200 (10MP DX) and D3x (24.5MP FX), DC at 0

sources.name: Phillip Reeve
sources.testBody: Sony A7R II (42MP FX) via adapter, 100% crops

entries.wideOpen: Slightly soft with strong LoCA; uneven across the frame
entries.source: Imaging Resource (D3x); Photozone (D200); Reeve (A7R II)
entries.note: Imaging Resource (D3x, 24.5MP): diffraction 'begins to set in very slightly' at f/11, no more than 1.5 blur units at f/16. On the Z8's finer pixels expect onset about a stop earlier (inference from pixel pitch, not measured).

sources.name: Photo Art From Science
sources.testBody: Nikon D7100 (24MP DX, about 3.9 µm pitch)

entries.wideOpen: Center very sharp; FX corners soft
entries.source: Photo Art From Science (D7100); Photozone (D200); Lenstip (D200); Kasson (D810)
entries.note: Curve is for focus at distance. At closer focus the strip shifts by the lens's own loss (1⅔ stops at 1:1, exposure factor 3.2). Photo Art From Science (D7100): softening begins at f/11 and is noticeable beyond it; Photozone: f/32 'still not good'.

sources.name: Photo Art From Science (Ed Dozier)
sources.testBody: Nikon D7000 (16MP DX, about 4.8 µm), MTF50 (single copy)

entries.wideOpen: Center decent to excellent; edges borderline; strong LoCA
entries.source: Photo Art From Science (D7000); Lenstip (D3x); Photozone (D3x)
entries.note: Photo Art From Science (D7000): peak f/5.6, resolution 'drops a bit' at f/8. Lenstip (D3x): f/4 and f/5.6 equal. Clearer loss at f/11–f/16. On the Z5 II (5.9 µm) f/8 costs little.

sources.name: OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: Fujifilm X APS-C body (model/MP not stated on the page)

sources.name: Dustin Abbott
sources.testBody: Sony a6500 (24MP APS-C) and a7RIII in APS-C mode

entries.wideOpen: Excellent center, very good borders; extreme corners good
entries.source: OpticalLimits (Fuji APS-C); Amateur Photographer (X-T3); Abbott (a6500)
entries.note: OpticalLimits: marginal impact at f/8, still impressive at f/16 (the marked f/22 is really about f/14–f/16). Amateur Photographer: visible softening beyond f/8. Peaks are for normal distances.

sources.name: Photozone/OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: Canon EOS 5Ds R (50MP FX, about 4.1 µm)

sources.name: The-Digital-Picture
sources.testBody: Canon EOS 5Ds R (50MP) for ISO 12233 crops. AF tests on 1D X II, 5Ds R, 77D

sources.name: Lenstip
sources.testBody: Canon EOS 5D Mark III (22MP FX), RAW MTF50

entries.wideOpen: Excellent across the frame
entries.source: Photozone (5Ds R); The Digital Picture (5Ds R); Lenstip (5D III)
entries.note: Photozone (50MP, 4.1 µm pitch, close to the Z8): diffraction first noticeable at f/8, f/11 still usable.

sources.name: Amateur Photographer
sources.testBody: Sony A6000/A6300/A7R APS-C crop (MTF via Applied Imaging, body unspecified)

entries.wideOpen: Center very sharp; APS-C corners softer from field curvature
entries.source: Amateur Photographer (APS-C MTF); Fstoppers (OM-1); Finding Range (X-T3)
entries.note: Amateur Photographer: slight drop already at f/8, though real images still looked sharp. No source measured f/11 on APS-C; f/11 mild loss and f/16 visibly softer is the best-supported reading.

sources.name: Amateur Photographer
sources.testBody: Sony A6500 (24MP APS-C) primary, A7 III crop

sources.name: OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: Sony APS-C body (not stated in excerpt)

entries.wideOpen: Excellent center; edges lag the center
entries.source: Digital Camera World (Imatest); Amateur Photographer (A6500); Abbott (a6400); OpticalLimits
entries.note: Digital Camera World (Imatest, Canon M): sharpness excellent through f/11, diffraction drop at f/16. Amateur Photographer: softening noticeable at f/16. OpticalLimits: superb to f/8.

sources.name: Dustin Abbott
sources.testBody: Sony a7RV (61MP) and Alpha 1 (50MP), M version via adapters

entries.wideOpen: Center good to very good; corners soft; heavy vignetting
entries.source: OpticalLimits (45MP Z); Abbott (a7R V, 61MP)
entries.note: Abbott (61MP): slight diffraction softening at f/11 and f/16, not severe. OpticalLimits: peak around f/5.6; numbers beyond were only in a chart image.

sources.name: Photozone (OpticalLimits)
sources.testBody: Nikon D3X (24.5MP FX) per sample-image captions

sources.name: Ken Rockwell
sources.testBody: Nikon D3 (12MP FX) and D7000 (16MP DX)

entries.wideOpen: Very good center and borders; FX corners one step softer
entries.source: Photozone (D200, D3x); DxOMark (D800); Lenstip (20D)
entries.note: Curve is for focus at distance. At 1:1 every set aperture is two stops smaller in effect, so the strip shifts by 2 stops. Photozone (DX): diffraction beyond about f/11; DxOMark (D800): still excellent at f/11 at distance. Rockwell (not measured): diffraction limits flat subjects by f/8.

sources.name: Photozone (OpticalLimits)
sources.testBody: Canon full-frame DSLR (model not named in text), adapted

entries.wideOpen: Center very good but low contrast; edges and corners soft
entries.source: Photozone (Canon FF DSLR); Lenstip (D3x); Reeve (A7R II)
entries.note: Photozone (lower-resolution Canon FF): diffraction slightly more obvious from f/11, still plenty sharp. On the Z8's finer pixels expect it a little earlier, about f/8–f/11 (inference).

sources.name: Thom Hogan, per owner curve brief

entries.wideOpen: Center very good; corners weaker
entries.source: PhotographyBlog (Z7); Thom Hogan; Lenstip (Z7); Abbott (Z8); Photography Life
entries.note: Slight drop at f/11, more at f/16, worst at f/22 but still fairly good. Corners never fully match the center.

entries.wideOpen: Center very good; midframe dips at f/4, fixed by f/5.6; corners need f/5.6
entries.source: PhotographyBlog (Z7); Thom Hogan; Lenstip (Z7); Abbott (Z8); Photography Life
entries.note: Lenstip (22mm, Z7): FF edge slightly weaker than at 14mm, sensible f/5.6–f/11. Abbott: midframe dip at f/4 fixed by f/5.6.

entries.wideOpen: Weakest focal length: center only decent at f/4, corners soft
entries.source: PhotographyBlog (Z7); Thom Hogan; Lenstip (Z7); Abbott (Z8); Photography Life
entries.note: Big center gain from f/4 to f/5.6; center excellent from f/5.6. Corners best at f/8–f/11 (Reeve: sharpest at f/11), sharp across the frame by f/11 (Lenstip). Abbott (Z8): very slight softening from f/11, obvious at f/22.

sources.name: Lenstip
sources.testBody: Nikon Z body not named in the fetched chapters

sources.name: OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: 45MP-normalized MTF (body not named in fetched text)

sources.name: Cameralabs
sources.testBody: Nikon Z8 (45.7MP), Siemens stars at ~45× focal length plus 1 km city scene, Lightroom with

entries.wideOpen: Extremely crisp center, even across the frame
entries.source: Lenstip; OpticalLimits (45MP); Cameralabs (Z8); Photography Life (Z8/Z9)
entries.note: Lenstip: strongest at 180mm, center over 67 lpmm wide open. OpticalLimits (45MP): f/11 already diffraction-affected.

entries.wideOpen: Center very good; FX corner best of its class at f/6
entries.source: Lenstip; OpticalLimits (45MP); Cameralabs (Z8); Photography Life (Z8/Z9)
entries.note: Cameralabs (Z8) at f/6: FX corner best of the group tested. Lenstip: mid-range center almost 59 lpmm wide open.

entries.wideOpen: Center only decent at f/6.3, FX corner a bit soft; sources disagree
entries.source: Lenstip; OpticalLimits (45MP); Cameralabs (Z8); Photography Life (Z8/Z9)
entries.note: Lenstip: center over 47 lpmm at f/8, diffraction ceiling about f/8. Cameralabs (Z8) and OpticalLimits saw little gain from stopping down; verdict f/8 when light allows.

entries.wideOpen: Center good at displayed f/9; FX corner decidedly soft
entries.source: Cameralabs (Z8) with TC-1.4x
entries.note: Cameralabs (Z8): good center at f/9, acuity improves a little at f/11. Nothing was tested past displayed f/11 with the TC-1.4x, so the drop-off uses the fallback. OpticalLimits advises against teleconverters (extra diffraction, not tested).

sources.name: OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: 45MP Nikon Z body (model not named on the page)

sources.name: Cameralabs
sources.testBody: Nikon Z7 (45.7MP), 100% crops, studio at ~45× focal length plus 1 km city test

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent; corners weak, extreme corners suffer field curvature
entries.source: Photo Art From Science (Z8); OpticalLimits (45MP); Abbott (Z8); Cameralabs (Z7)
entries.note: Dozier (Z8) f/4: center 76.4, worst corner 43.2 lp/mm. Abbott: f/5.6 improves mid-frame and corners; f/8 narrows but never fully closes the extreme-corner gap. Abbott (Z8): softening begins after f/8, minimal at f/11; Dozier stopped testing at f/16 because diffraction 'destroys the resolution'.

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent; corners moderate, flatter field at f/5.6
entries.source: Photo Art From Science (Z8); OpticalLimits (45MP); Abbott (Z8); Cameralabs (Z7)
entries.note: Dozier (Z8) f/4: center 77.4, corner 43.2 lp/mm. Abbott: crisp and flatter-field at f/5.6.

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent; corners softer but usable
entries.source: Photo Art From Science (Z8); OpticalLimits (45MP); Abbott (Z8); Cameralabs (Z7)
entries.note: Dozier (Z8) f/4: center 66.5, corner 41.2 lp/mm. Cameralabs: f/5.6–f/8 improves corners.

sources.name: Phillip Reeve
sources.testBody: Nikon Z7 II (45.7MP FX) and Nikon Z fc (20.9MP DX)

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent; FX corners slightly below decency, strong coma
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); Photography Life (Z7); Reeve (Z7 II)
entries.note: Reeve (Z7 II): sharpness drops slightly at f/16. Lenstip, Photography Life and Cameralabs did not discuss diffraction; on the 45.7MP Z8 expect a small loss by f/11 (inference). FX corners stay weak at every aperture.

sources.name: Phillip Reeve
sources.testBody: Nikon Z7 II (45.7MP), plus a DX body for the APS-C results

entries.wideOpen: Center good but not at peak; FX edge at the decency floor
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); Photography Life (Z7); Reeve (Z7 II)
entries.note: Photography Life (Z7): sharpness weakens gradually from the f/5.6 peak toward f/16. Reeve: slight FX softness at f/16 (on DX from f/11). On the Z8, f/8 is the last 'free' stop.

entries.wideOpen: Center fair; edges blurry near f/2; strong vignetting and coma
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); Photography Life (Z7); Reeve (Z7 II)
entries.note: Reeve (Z7 II): negligible diffraction hit at f/11, more obvious at f/16, especially in the corners. Corners never reach excellent.

sources.name: Phillip Reeve
sources.testBody: Nikon Z7 II (45.7MP), plus Z fc and Z f samples

entries.wideOpen: Center outstanding; FX corners only fair
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); DXOMARK (Z7); Reeve (Z7 II); OpticalLimits (Z50)
entries.note: DXOMARK (Z7): diffraction starts to cut sharpness around f/5.6–f/8, most visible from f/11. OpticalLimits (Z50, DX): resolution drops from f/8.

sources.name: OpticalLimits
sources.testBody: 45MP-normalized results (body not named in fetched text)

sources.name: Mirrorlesscomparison
sources.testBody: Nikon Z6 and Z7 (also Z7 DX crop)

entries.wideOpen: Excellent: center over 80 lpmm, slight corner drop
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); OpticalLimits (45MP); Imaging Resource (Z7); Photography Life; Mirrorlesscomparison
entries.note: OpticalLimits (45MP): visible impact from f/8. Imaging Resource (Z7): noticeable at f/11 but usable; f/16–f/22 very soft. Mirrorlesscomparison: starts at f/11, more at f/16.

entries.wideOpen: Excellent; corners already very good
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); OpticalLimits (45MP); Imaging Resource (Z7); Photography Life; Mirrorlesscomparison
entries.note: Photography Life: corners strongest at 105mm, very high at f/5.6.

entries.wideOpen: Excellent; borders drop to very good only at f/2.8
entries.source: Lenstip (Z7); OpticalLimits (45MP); Imaging Resource (Z7); Photography Life; Mirrorlesscomparison
entries.note: Photography Life: f/2.8, f/4 and f/5.6 essentially equal at 200mm; OpticalLimits: only here does f/4 slightly improve the corners.

entries.wideOpen: At displayed f/4: noticeably softer than bare 200 f/2.8 ('not too bad'); f/5.6 very crisp
entries.source: Imaging Resource (Z7); Cameralabs (45MP); Mirrorlesscomparison
entries.note: Imaging Resource (Z7): f/5.6 very crisp, only slightly behind the bare lens. With the TC-1.4x, diffraction follows the displayed f-number, so displayed f/8 is the limit for detail on the Z8 (inference), and the drop-off uses the fallback.

sources.name: Photography Life
sources.testBody: Nikon DX Z body (not named in text)

sources.name: Enrico Savazzi
sources.testBody: Nikon Z50 II (20.9MP DX), handheld, visual crops

entries.wideOpen: Center at its best wide open; corners only slightly softer
entries.source: Photography Life (DX lab); Savazzi (Z50 II); Hogan (Z30); Rockwell (Z8 DX crop)
entries.note: Savazzi (Z50 II): center unchanged to f/11; slight but detectable blur at f/16. Rockwell (Z8 DX crop): softer from f/11. Best-supported: f/11 is the last 'free' stop, f/16 visibly soft.

entries.wideOpen: Sharp wide open; mid-range consistent with the ends
entries.source: Photography Life (DX lab); Savazzi (Z50 II); Hogan (Z30); Rockwell (Z8 DX crop)
entries.note: Not reported separately: Photography Life and Hogan describe the mid-range as consistent with the ends (inferred plateau).

entries.wideOpen: Weakest focal length, but still good
entries.source: Photography Life (DX lab); Savazzi (Z50 II); Hogan (Z30); Rockwell (Z8 DX crop)
entries.note: Photography Life: 'a little weaker at 28mm'. Savazzi (Z50 II): no corner/center difference at 28mm.

sources.name: PhotoReview (Australia)
sources.testBody: Nikon Z50 (20.9MP DX), Imatest JPEG plus raw

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent; corners weak from field curvature, much better at f/5.6
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: Sources disagree on onset. PhotoReview (Imatest): consistent to about f/8, diffraction between f/10 and f/11. Hogan: softening starts between f/5.6 and f/8. Best-supported: f/8 safe, f/11 measurable loss, f/16 and smaller avoid.

entries.wideOpen: Strong center and extreme corners; best overall at f/5.6
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: Photography Life: f/5.6 gives the best overall results at 24mm.

entries.wideOpen: Center very good, corners solidly good; use max aperture unless you need depth
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: Photography Life: use maximum aperture at 50mm unless you need more depth of field.

sources.name: PhotoReview (Australia)
sources.testBody: Nikon Z50 (20.9MP DX), Imatest on JPEG and NEF

entries.wideOpen: Center barely changes f/3.5 to f/5.6; corners need f/5.6
entries.source: PhotoReview (Z50); Photography Life; Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: PhotoReview (Imatest, Z50): diffraction noticeable from about f/10, resolution drops sharply from f/11 to f/22 at all focal lengths. Avoid f/16 and smaller except for sunstars.

entries.wideOpen: Corners very good wide open, nearly matching the center
entries.source: PhotoReview (Z50); Photography Life; Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: Hogan: corners nearly match the center at 50–70mm.

entries.wideOpen: Center good, corners good to fair and inconsistent
entries.source: PhotoReview (Z50); Photography Life; Hogan (Z50)
entries.note: Hogan: stop down 1–2 stops from f/6.3 at the long end. PhotoReview: center falls a little short beyond 70mm.

entries.wideOpen: Similar to the 16-50 at 50mm; stopping down pulls the corners in
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50); Rockwell (Z50)
entries.note: Hogan (Z50): avoid f/11 through f/22. No lab source published a measured onset. On the Z50 II (4.2 µm), f/8 is the practical ceiling.

entries.wideOpen: Slightly weaker overall; f/5.6 is the sweet spot
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50); Rockwell (Z50)
entries.note: Photography Life: f/5.6 sweet spot at 135mm. Hogan: corners second-best.

entries.wideOpen: Weakest focal length: worst wide open, corners fair
entries.source: Photography Life (Z50); PhotoReview (Z50); Hogan (Z50); Rockwell (Z50)
entries.note: Photography Life: worst at 250mm, especially wide open; stop down to f/8. Hogan: center good, corners fair. Sources differ, so try f/8 when shutter speed allows.

sources.name: Enrico Savazzi
sources.testBody: Nikon Z8 (45.7MP), resolution target at 1:1. Handling also on a Z50 II

sources.name: Photography Life
sources.testBody: Not stated on the page (lab chart image not readable)

sources.name: Cameralabs
sources.testBody: Nikon Z7 (45.7MP), Siemens star and real-world crops

entries.wideOpen: Very sharp into the corners at f/2.8
entries.source: OpticalLimits (45MP); Photography Life; Savazzi (Z8, 1:1); Lenstip (Z7); Cameralabs (Z7)
entries.note: OpticalLimits (45MP): diffraction sets in from about f/8; f/11 still very usable, f/16 softer, avoid f/22 for high-resolution work.

entries.wideOpen: Wide open at 1:1 reads f/4.5 (close-focus loss included); no separate close-range verdict researched
entries.source: OpticalLimits (45MP); Photography Life; Savazzi (Z8, 1:1); Lenstip (Z7); Cameralabs (Z7)
entries.note: The camera shows the effective aperture, so these are displayed numbers. Savazzi (Z8) saw slight diffraction loss by f/8 at the finest detail and a further drop at f/11. Only a whole-frame peak was researched at 1:1, so Center and Corners are not measured separately. Focus-stack at f/5.6–f/8 instead of going to f/16+.

sources.name: Photozone (OpticalLimits)
sources.testBody: Canon full-frame DSLR (model not named in text

entries.wideOpen: Center excellent, corners good; Digital Picture: corners somewhat soft
entries.source: Reeve (Z7 II, 46MP); Photozone (Canon FF); The Digital Picture (5Ds R)
entries.note: Reeve (46MP): diffraction reduces sharpness from f/16 at infinity and from f/11 at close range; f/22 visibly softer. Photozone (lower resolution): noticeable from f/8, easily usable at f/11.
